_comment: Role Knowledge Manifest (ADR-024, PROPOSED). Input of scripts/setup/gen-role-packages.py. Units select source text by exact heading (and optionally by the opening words of blocks, or by exact lines); a renamed heading stops generation. Every block of a role file must be claimed by exactly one unit. Delivery: always_loaded and command_reference are verified channels in the managed AGENTS.md. skill_assigned is a Paperclip skill, not verified until a run opens it. on_demand_verified is a channel the agent can open without a paste (project Task Workspace). on_request is a fallback, not verified delivery. not_delivered omits a unit only when the same requirements stay in a verified channel (lexical lint, not semantic equivalence). Do not drop a duty because the normative-sentence detector missed its wording. The budget applies only to roles named in applies_to. Status: approved / proposed / experimental / superseded. Generated output is never edited by hand.

studio-art-identity-and-refinement.title: Studio skill: art identity and targeted refinement
studio-art-identity-and-refinement.description: Game-artist procedure for refining an approved asset or drawing a new pose, view or state while keeping the entity's identity: three lists (identity invariants, pose-specific properties, replaceable representations), seed choice by evidence, smallest-change refinement with the allowed comfy-edit and art-ops commands.
studio-art-identity-and-refinement.authority: KA-BD-2 (Board 2026-11-23, approved with amendment); Art Production v2 pilot (Board 2026-11-22); KD-BD-9 pilot change C (preparation only)
studio-art-identity-and-refinement.reference_intro: Copied from Company OS at the source commit in the first line; each part names its source. When this text and your role instructions differ, your role instructions win and you say so in your Task comment.
studio-art-identity-and-refinement.purpose: Keep an entity recognisably itself when you refine an approved asset or redraw it in a new pose, view or state, and choose seeds by evidence instead of habit. It adds no rule and grants no permission: every mandatory rule is in your role instructions, and the permission layer decides what you may run.
activation: the Task asks for a targeted refinement of an approved asset (one listed defect, one region);
the Task asks for a new action pose, alternate view, transformation state, new bind pose, or rig-ready / animation-driven art of an existing entity;
you are about to choose or reuse a seed for a variant of an existing asset.
procedure: Open `reference/seed-and-identity.md` (this skill's supporting file) and the Task's brief; write the three lists: identity invariants, pose-specific properties, replaceable representations. Ask in your Task comment when the brief does not give them.

Targeted refinement: change only the listed issue. Make a mask with `python -I ~/game-studio-workspace/tools/art-ops.py mask` and repaint that region with `python -I ~/game-studio-workspace/tools/comfy-edit.py inpaint` (SDXL), or use `python -I ~/game-studio-workspace/tools/comfy-edit.py img2img` at low denoise for family consistency.
New pose, view or state: judge the result against the identity invariants, not against the source pixels or silhouette, and list which pose-specific properties changed.
Seeds: treat a reused seed as one candidate to test; record every seed, its result and why you kept or rejected it.

Compare before and after at target size with `python -I ~/game-studio-workspace/tools/art-ops.py contact` and check unintended changes with `python -I ~/game-studio-workspace/tools/art-ops.py diff`; revert a fix that breaks an invariant.
When no allowed command can carry the invariants into the new pose, post the blocker lines (`Type: permission` or `decision`) as your role instructions say; never work around a refusal.
